summary: Dataset Details now shows sidecar Precedents as clickable chips above Dependents.
details: The Precedents box uses the same compact dependency-chip style as Dependents and includes sources that are not visible in the formula text.
Dependency formula tooltips now show the formula directly with an equals token instead of repeating the hovered dataset name.
Formula tooltips have a wider cap and shrink to the widest wrapped row to avoid excess blank space.
Dataset Details inputs and graph boxes now fill the available panel width as the window resizes.
